mission: Long-range sensors detect another ship on parallel course toward Veranthos. Veraine is visible now. The convergence tightens.
why_now: Transition toward Chapter 18 — the physical convergence of all parties toward Veranthos begins
conflict: The tactical situation is now a race to a fixed point. Veraine is on approach. The group must decide their approach vector and what they'll do when they arrive.
turning_point: Desh confirms: Veraine's ship is running a course that will arrive at Veranthos roughly simultaneously with them. She's not fleeing. She's not waiting. She timed this. She wants them there for the endgame.
opening_hook: Desh: 'Contact. Bearing three-one-five, parallel course.' A pause. 'It's her.'
closing_hook: Two ships converging on a world where the Force was torn a thousand years ago. Torin watches the nav display with the expression of a man coming home.
emotional_trajectory: Tactical alertness -> grim inevitability -> Torin's unsettling anticipation

stakes.personal: The endgame approaching — no more preparation time
stakes.interpersonal: Torin's anticipation contrasting with everyone else's dread

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — cockpit, sensor displays
sensory_details: Sensor contact on the display — a small bright dot on a parallel trajectory; Desh's professional calm masking concern; Torin's reflection in the viewport, watching the stars with anticipation
notes: H18 planted — parallel course to Veranthos. The physical convergence mirrors the thematic convergence. Torin's expression should be the chapter's final image — a man looking forward to something that should terrify him.
